envelope.description: Write and remove the marked hook block

body.title: Write and remove the marked hook block
body.summary: Add the module that builds the marked hook block for a given hook entry path, applies it to a hook file of any starting shape (absent, empty, husky-style, user-written, already carrying the block) through a temporary file and a rename keeping or setting the executable mode, and removes only the marked block, deleting a file that held nothing else.
acceptanceChecks: The block is written into an absent, an empty, a husky-style and a user-written file and the existing content is kept byte for byte
Applying twice leaves one block, removing leaves the original content, and a file that held only the block is deleted
A file that cannot be written is reported with its reason and left unchanged, and the file mode is kept or made executable
